init.title: Schedule settings
init.description:
Each waste type gets its own calendar (with its own colour in the Calendar panel). Untick the types you do not need, e.g. BIO if you compost.

Rounds ZGK publishes only as a weekday (usually mixed and BIO) are drawn weekly. Manual changes, one per line:
`11.11.2026 > 12.11.2026` moves every pickup on that day,
`zmieszane 11.11.2026 > 12.11.2026` one type only,
`bio 11.11.2026 > brak` cancels a pickup,
`+ 14.11.2026 bio` adds one.
Types: zmieszane, selektywne, bio, gabaryty.
